objective: Create a production-source-identical staging Android APK baseline, then publish only frozen Community Wall RC to staging-user after backend, channel and runtime safety gates.
productionBaselineEvidence: verified: GitHub production Android OTA run 42183558084 used exact source 8e1956e617a65b3350b3fba81597fc86604da4a1, runtime 1.3.2, update 01a1afda-304b-72a7-a859-8799f25ac602. The Nov 1 staging APK from 35431cd is stale; production OTA and APK are never changed here.
chosenApproach: Checkout main exact SHA for staged APK, Wall RC exact SHA for staging OTA. Apply only transient staging app package/version/EAS production-connected backend settings while keeping live source/assets unmodified.
selectionRationale: Old staging branch is behind and diverged. Current logo files match but APK contains historical native/UI implementation; rebuild from canonical source instead of reusing older staging code.
alternativeApproaches: Keep historical APK and OTA over it: rejected because native logo and binary baseline cannot be updated over JS OTA alone.
Merge old staging branch into main: rejected due stale implementation and lost approved features.
Publish to production to compare: rejected, staging approval only.
